mapper.insert: WITH expired AS ( UPDATE app.point_grant SET status = '2', expired_date = #{targetDate}, updated_at = now() WHERE status = '1' AND expiry_date < #{targetDate} RETURNING point_grant_id, member_id, points, granted_date, expiry_date ) INSERT INTO app.point_expiry_history ( point_grant_id, member_id, points, granted_date, expiry_date, expired_date, created_at ) SELECT point_grant_id, member_id, points, granted_date, expiry_date, #{targetDate}, now() FROM expired
